F.the_resource_and_metric: Grid-wide reduction-tree / occupancy cost. The metric that moves (verified in the lowered Triton, compile-only) is the number of grid partials the final `gb_blocks.sum(0)` collapses. FLOORED T2 default (block_sizes=[1,1]) emits `_launcher(_helion_bias_grad_bwd, (16384,), ...)` -> a grid of M=16384 programs, each storing one partial row into gb_blocks -> the finalize is an M-way (16384-partial) reduction (G~0.35). LEVER (block_sizes=[128,128]) emits `_launcher(..., ((16384 + _BLOCK_SIZE_0 - 1) // _BLOCK_SIZE_0,), ...)` = (16384+128-1)//128 = 128 programs -> gb_blocks has ~num_sm(=132)-sized partial count -> the M-way finalize SHRINKS from 16384 to 128 partials. Exactly the stated mechanism: occupancy-size the CTA so the finalize is over ~one wave, not the whole M axis.
F.the_predicted_boundary: M_COLLAPSE_MAX_CTA=256 rows per CTA = the in-register reduction-tree / [rows,feature] resident-tile spill point. Confirmed binding compile-only: bias_grad (65536,1024) raw next_pow2(M/num_sm)=512 -> seed capped to [256,256]; (262144,1024) raw=2048 -> still [256,256]; (16384,1024) raw=128 -> [128,128] (cap inert below it). Measured crossover (recorded): 512 rows 0.21x vs 256 rows 1.00x. Boundary keyed on occupancy grid_rows//num_sm (num_sm=132 real H100), not a curriculum constant.
